visual_identity.core_identity: Predatory shapechangers that remain convincingly recognizable as the object they imitate while revealing organic seams, mouth, tongue, eye, or pseudopod details.
visual_identity.silhouette: Primary silhouette remains the disguised object; monster anatomy emerges from existing panels, seams, hinges, or hardware.
visual_identity.head_features: No separate animal or humanoid head; facial elements integrate into the object.
visual_identity.body_shape: Object structure stays readable while selected parts flex or transform organically.
visual_identity.surface: Object material remains dominant with restrained fleshy reveal details.
must_avoid: full transformation that destroys object identity
visual_identity.limb_structure: No separate biological limbs by default. Tongue, pseudopods, hinges, panels, seams, and hardware emerge from or remain integrated with the disguised object's structure.

accuracy_checks: no unrelated creature anatomy replaces the disguise

known_failure_modes.symptom: mimic becomes a creature standing behind or inside the object
known_failure_modes.correction: merge mouth, eye, tongue, and organic seams into the object itself
use predatory irregular reveal integrated into seams and hardware

scene_identity.size_impression: Reads first at the believable scale of the disguised object; monstrous anatomy must not inflate it into an unrelated beast.
scene_identity.natural_posture: The disguised object remains planted, hung, framed, or otherwise physically supported while the reveal opens through existing seams or surfaces.
behavior_style: waiting in a convincing object disguise
opening a predatory reveal through an existing seam, lid, or panel
reaching with one integrated tongue or pseudopod while preserving object identity
environment_fit: storage rooms, ruins, or furnished spaces where the disguised object plausibly belongs
